blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The bells of the St. Gregory the Great Albay Cathedral and its chapels will ring for one minute at 4 p.m. every day to remind residents to clean their surroundings and eliminate mosquito breeding sites. Rev. Fr. Lyndon Balubar, parish priest, said the initiative was in response to a request from the Albay Provincial Health Office for the Church’s help in raising awareness about dengue prevention. “We received a letter from the provincial government, particularly the Provincial Health Office, asking for the help of priests in informing the public about efforts to combat dengue by ringing the bells,” […]...
